As a side note, a couple years ago, making this benchmark & analysis would’ve taken a considerable amount of time in STATA, likely several days, and making it look this nice would have been quite a while as well. This was like 4 prompts to Fable 5.2 AI is getting better faster than our measurements are I threw together SatBench, which measures how quickly major AI benchmarks become saturated (effectively beaten). Of 173 benchmarks cited by the Labs since 2023, 63% are now saturated. Saturation is happening faster each year.
